products.name: Windows Domain Secure-Channel & Netlogon Health Diagnostics Toolkit — Commercial
products.short_description: Find and fix the real cause of Netlogon Event ID 5719 on domain-joined Windows PCs — broken secure channel, DNS/DC-locator, Kerberos time skew, blocked DC ports, or an invalid IPv6 config — with read-only endpoint PowerShell you run locally or via Intune Proactive Remediations. Repair defaults to a safe preview. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Stop guessing at Netlogon Event ID 5719

Domain-joined Windows devices intermittently fail to log on, drop mapped drives, or lose Group Policy — and the System log fills with Netlogon Event ID 5719: "There are currently no logon servers available." That one message hides several very different causes: a broken secure channel (machine-account/trust password out of sync), DNS that can't locate a domain controller, clock skew that breaks Kerberos, blocked DC ports, no reachable DC at boot, a NIC power-management race — and, surprisingly often, an invalidly disabled IPv6 stack. This toolkit finds which one it is and fixes it, on one device or ten thousand.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, step-by-step documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run endpoint PowerShell (in-box commands only, nothing to install).

  • Simpler — one Discovery pass replaces a scavenger hunt across Event Viewer, nltest, w32tm, DNS, and the registry; every output folder and object you use is named and reused.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every device and every incident.
  • Tested — the repeatable diagnostics arc (Assess → Diagnose → Repair → Validate → Prevent) with explicit pass/fail gates and read-only-by-default scripts.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what Event ID 5719 actually means and the full root-cause tree (DNS/DC-locator, secure channel/trust, Kerberos time skew, DC ports 88/135/389/445, no DC path, the boot-time NIC/power race, and IPv6), plus the correct IPv6 recommended configuration.
  • Requirements Guide — every device/tooling/network prerequisite with how to verify and implement each.
  • Implementation Guide — exact steps to triage one device and to deploy at scale via Intune Proactive Remediations (detection + remediation), with full navigation paths.
  • 5 endpoint PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Validation, Report, Collect (read-only) and Remediation (safe, -WhatIf by default).
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides plus Best Practices for preventing recurrence (NIC power-off, wait-for-network, internal DNS, time hierarchy, IPv6 stays enabled).

The IPv6 finding, done right

Keep IPv6 enabled (the dual-stack default, 0x0). This toolkit never disables IPv6 — it identifies invalid DisabledComponents values (e.g. 0xffffffff) and corrects them back to a supported value. Disabling IPv6 breaks DirectAccess, Remote Assistance, and HomeGroup and is unsupported by Microsoft's testing.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each incident feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next device and the next project.

The bottom line

The true cause of Event ID 5719 identified and repaired on any domain-joined Windows device, IPv6 restored to a supported configuration, and a fleet-wide health check you can run on demand.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, step-by-step solution: solution overview, requirements, implementation (local + Proactive Remediations), testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run endpoint scripts (read-only diagnostics; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • NETLOGONDX-Discovery.ps1 — one-pass collector of every secure-channel / Netlogon signal (5719 events, secure channel, DC locator, DNS SRV, time, DC ports, IPv6)
    • NETLOGONDX-Validation.ps1 — pass/fail health gate; doubles as the Proactive Remediations detection script
    • NETLOGONDX-Report.ps1 — readable + CSV health summary for fleet roll-up
    • NETLOGONDX-Remediation.ps1 — safe repair of secure channel, time, and invalid IPv6 config (defaults to -WhatIf)
    • NETLOGONDX-Collect.ps1 — bundles logs and command output into one ZIP for escalation

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
